R0002.title: Coupon Enumeration
R0002.definition: Bulk enumeration of coupon codes, redemption codes, discount codes, and other promotional voucher credentials.
R0002.description: When voucher numbers are generated from rule-based sequences, short code lengths, or guessable algorithms, attackers can obtain valid codes in bulk through brute-force enumeration, sample analysis, or algorithm cracking. This risk commonly appears on redemption-code, coupon-code, gift-card, invitation-code, and discount-code validation APIs. Without high-entropy random voucher code generation, failed-attempt limits, and abnormal redemption monitoring, attackers can keep probing with automation scripts until valid codes are found.
R0002.influence: Exploits platform promotional benefits and occupies resources intended for legitimate users.

references.title: OWASP Automated Threat: OAT002 Token Cracking

observables: The coupon redemption endpoint shows a burst of mostly-failing requests with occasional successes in a short window
